preface.title: Introduction
preface.para: &project:name; is an open source server-side and client-side modification for &et:name;. It is a fork of jaymod, building on its foundation with modern features, 64-bit platform support, an integrated anticheat system (JXAC), Lua scripting, and a SQLite database backend.

&project:name; provides extensive gameplay customization, a powerful admin system, and client-side enhancements. Only one pak file needs to be downloaded (on the fly) for clients connecting to a &project:name; server for the first time.
&project:name; supports both 32-bit and 64-bit platforms on &linux:name; and &windows:name;. The codebase is written in C++ and originally forked from the &et:sdk;.

section.title: Where to download
section.para: &project:name; is available for download at its official home . You may find versions available elsewhere on the internet, but if at all possible download it from the official homepage, as it always has the most up-to-date version available.

section.title: Further information and suggestions
section.para: If there is anything that isn’t answered here, I urge you to visit the website at for updated information, as it’s more likely to have information not available at the time this document was published.
Also, I’m always on the lookout for good ideas or suggestions, so, again, please visit the website and let me know what you think!
